notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 80-82) does not contain the Art History A.A-T section. It shows the end of another Art award (Printmaking/Sculpture lists), the 'Associate in Arts Degree: Art' (Units Required: 27, with its own Degree Student Learning Outcome), and ART/ARTH course descriptions. None of these were recorded as the Art History A.A-T requirements.
The Art History A.A-T requirements likely appear on a nearby page (probably page 79 or earlier); a reviewer should locate that section.

ARTH C1100 and ARTH C1200 are the renumbered forms of ART-110 and ART-111 ('Formerly ART-110', 'Formerly ART-111'), so the A.A-T section would likely list ARTH-C1100/C1200 rather than the closed-list ART 110/111.

The outcome printed in the text ('Students will be able to analyze and interpret works of cultural importance.') belongs to the Associate in Arts Degree: Art, not to this award, so it was not recorded.
